star_full_quantified.situation: In May 2025 at Helix Studio the insights squad could not agree why week-two retention dropped.
star_full_quantified.task: I was asked to find a cause the product lead could act on within one week.
star_full_quantified.action: I pulled trial cohorts in SQL, compared first-session dashboard opens across six weeks, built a chart of the churn split, walked the product lead through the two clearest options, and rewrote the query so the squad could rerun it every Monday without me.
star_full_quantified.result: Users who never opened the dashboard churned at almost twice the rate; the team shipped a simpler first-run prompt and retention recovered 6 percent within three weeks.
